name: To Clarify Beef Drippings
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: drippings accumulated from different cooked meats of beef or veal
ingredients.originalText: drippings accumulated from different cooked meats of beef or veal

instructions.text: Put it into a basin and slicing into it a raw potato, allowing it to boil long enough for the potato to brown, which causes all impurities to disappear
Remove from the fire, and when cool drain it off from the sediment that settles at the bottom
Turn it into basins or small jars and set it in a cool place for future use

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put it into a basin and slicing into it a raw potato, allowing it to boil long enough for the potato to brown, which causes all impurities to disappear
2. Remove from the fire, and when cool drain it off from the sediment that settles at the bottom
3. Turn it into basins or small jars and set it in a cool place for future use
